methodology: A/B test of every claude-skills library skill not already calibrated via the Spacepotatis run (ai-codegen-smell-audit and security-audit excluded — already in SKILL-CALIBRATION-LATEST.json). Arm A: Sonnet sub-agent solves the task cold, no SKILL.md access, explicit instruction not to read .claude/skills/ or CLAUDE.md. Arm B: Sonnet sub-agent reads d:/koodaamista/claude-skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and follows it. Both arms produced a real artifact (markdown plan, audit report, or proposed change), no side-effect commands executed. Token usage from harness's per-sub-agent usage.total_tokens — input + output + cache_creation; cache_read excluded. N=1 per skill.

task_briefs.audit: Multi-phase robustness audit of mikkonumminen.dev/src/. Produce findings with severity tags.
task_briefs.mikko-audit-suite: Plan which mikko-* audits to run on mikkonumminen.dev and in what order. Index document only.
task_briefs.mikko-help: List installed mikko-* skills at ~/.claude/skills/ with descriptions. Markdown summary.
task_briefs.mikko-install: Plan installing all mikko-* skills from claude-skills/skills/ to ~/.claude/skills/. Plan only, no actual copies.
task_briefs.react-anti-patterns-audit: Audit mikkonumminen.dev/src/ for React anti-patterns (key=index, useEffect derived state, etc.).
task_briefs.readme-drift-sync: Detect drift between mikkonumminen.dev/README.md and the repo's actual state. Report only, no rewrites.
task_briefs.session-cost: Compute the token cost of session 47fcb7d8-762b-45af-ae2a-b9e4af3c295b. Main thread + sub-agents breakdown.
task_briefs.skill-calibration: Plan an A/B calibration for a hypothetical /example-skill in AudiobookMaker. Plan only, no actual dispatch.
task_briefs.skill-usage: Scan local Claude Code JSONLs and produce a per-skill usage summary for the last 90 days.

skills.name: mikko-audit-suite
skills.notes: skill encodes detection-then-plan rigor — arm A's freestyle was tighter on this specific task; recipe overhead exceeded the focus benefit at this scale.

skills.name: mikko-help
skills.notes: skill encodes a source-repo cross-check on top of the install scan — extra work for completeness, costs more than just listing installed skills.

skills.name: mikko-install
skills.notes: skill encodes the full install protocol (modes, prefixing, source-repo validation) — costs more than a plain cp pass; value is in correctness, not token compression.

skills.name: react-anti-patterns-audit
skills.notes: target had no React; both arms correctly returned no findings. Arm B's structured pre-flight + abort cost more than arm A's quick check. N=1 on a negative-result target; positive-result repos would likely differ.

skills.name: readme-drift-sync
skills.notes: biggest cost-more in this calibration. Skill encodes a thorough multi-axis drift detection + rewrite-in-voice procedure. Arm A scouted faster and produced 8 findings with file:line; arm B used 63 tool uses against arm A's 37 doing the structured walk. Skill's value is rewrite quality, not detection speed.

skills.name: session-cost
skills.notes: arm B ran the prescribed scan.mjs directly; arm A wrote a JSONL walker from scratch. Modest save from delegating to the existing tool.

skills.name: skill-calibration
skills.notes: SKILL.md is detailed (modes, flags, worktree management, output schema); arm A wrote a sparse plan that wouldn't have actually worked. Cost-more reflects spec depth, not waste.

skills.name: skill-usage
skills.notes: biggest save in this calibration. Recipe says 'run scan.mjs'; arm A wrote a from-scratch JSONL walker including dedup logic. Big save from delegating to the existing tool.

cross_portfolio_observation: claude-skills aggregate -10% saved is the OPPOSITE direction from Spacepotatis (+22%) and AudiobookMaker (+23%). Library / meta skills (audit orchestrators, help listings, install protocols, calibration runners, drift-sync) encode protocol rigor, completeness, or detailed spec following — the recipe IS the work. Their value is correctness, not token compression. The two skills that delegate to an existing tool (skill-usage, session-cost) save tokens by saying 'run scan.mjs' instead of re-implementing it; that's the cleanest savings pattern. The two pure-scaffolding skills in this set (none — they all encode procedure) would have shown the +20-50% saves the Spacepotatis / AudiobookMaker scaffolding skills showed.
